notes.title: Bulletin of Modifications and Improvements: June 6, 2013
notes.content:
Based on user feedback, we've made a few adjustments:

- Added Bubble Icons switch to settings (default is off) to help address colour perception difficulties.
- Added Invert Keys switch to settings (default is off) for keyboard controls.
- Added Key Sensitivity slider to settings.
- Escape key no longer quits; pauses and unpauses in-game, goes back a level within menus.
- Added Settings option to pause menu.

notes.title: Now Available - Cranky Cat
notes.content:
Cranky Cat is Now Available on Steam!

Enjoy hours of bubble-popping madness with this absurdly fun and addictive color-matching puzzle game! Described as a 360-degree Bust-a-Move with a steampunk motif, Cranky Cat allows for hours of bubble-popping madness with numerous modes of gameplay.
